newsitem.title: DUBAI: Share price gains gather pace on Saudi market.
newsitem.headline: Share price gains gather pace on Saudi market.

text.p: Share price gains gathered momentum on an active Saudi Arabian stock exchange last week, figures from the Riyadh-based Bakheet Financial Advisors (BFA) and the official Saudi Press Agency (SPA) showed on Sunday.
The index was up over two percent at 142.55 points in the week to Thursday from 138.95 a week earlier, BFA said.
SPA said 4.146 million shares worth 853.62 million riyals changed hands in the week. The previous week 5.14 million shares worth 655.58 million riyals were traded, BFA has said.
SPA said cement shares dominated trade, accounting for around 32 percent of total volume. The services and banking sector followed, each accounting for about 20 percent.
SPA said 57 companies were traded in the week. Share prices of 39 rose, 12 dropped and the rest were unchanged.
Al-Gassim Agriculture Co was the biggest gainer with its share price up 8.7 percent at 25 from 23 riyals at the start of the week's trade, BFA figures show.
With some 608,000 shares traded, Arab Cement was the most active share by volume, accounting for almost 15 percent of total turnover, BFA said.

Other active shares included Saudi Basic Industries Corp, which accounted for some 10 percent of volume traded. It closed at 394 riyals on Thursday from 385 riyals at the start of the week's trade. ($1=3.75 riyals)
